title: Cute Ghost totem by gsime
description: Changing Totem into cute ghost textures
body:
Cute Ghost Totem is a small Minecraft resource pack that changes the Totem of Undying into a cute ghost. The design is simple, clean, and made to fit the vanilla Minecraft style.

This resource pack is perfect for players who want a fun and cute look in their game without changing too many textures. It is lightweight, easy to use, and works well with other resource packs.

feature
- Makes the Totem of Undying more fun and interesting
